metadata.question: Can distinct-radius concentric inclined loops preserve adaptive field stability while clearing 20 mm conductors?
metadata.evidenceGrade: smoke-to-candidate control sweep; instantaneous vacuum field and loss proxies only

definitions.target: uniform vector field over 27 central-cube probes; nominal axial magnitude 0.4
definitions.runtimeRelativeToMain: main-only loss divided by adaptive loss when every coil retains the main coil's conductor gauge; this adds copper with coil count
definitions.runtimeRelativeFixedCopper: main-only loss divided by coil-count-scaled adaptive loss when total conductor cross-section is held fixed
definitions.controller: projected-gradient bounded feedback allocation over the main loop and all satellites
